==Description==
'''Slowed''' is a tag used to display that the enemy is affected by a status effect that slows down enemies.

==Mechanics==
'''Slowed''', when applied, this will result in them being slowed down by a specific percentage. As '''Slowed''' is not used by any specific debuff, effects which add the '''Slowed''' to enemies can often stack.

==Enemy List==
The following can apply '''Slowed''' effects to enemies:
*[[Slime Trooper]]
*[[Hacker]]
*[[DJ Booth]]
*[[Flash Bang]] ([[Boss]] only, all other enemies get stunned)
